title: Reputable
tagline: REPUtable makes it easy for users to create their own tokens. Tokens may be used for various services. Since all tokens have a common total supply and inflation rate, the price becomes personal credit~reputation~. It is useful for designing credit-based apps such as credit loans.
description:
We, D3LAB, believe Web3 Reputation is the key to activating the Web3 ecosystem. We suggest REPUtable, the decentralized reputation platform that can show numerical scores as the address's credit.

- 📈 REPUtable: REPUtable is Personal-Platform-as-a-Service. Anyone in Web3 can mint their own personal token and build a DApp ecosystem based on the token and the token price in our reputation platform.
In the REPUtable, users can get more REPU by staking a REPU token or the form of REPU-USDT LP. In contrast, someone could feel some personal token is more valuable than staking REPU. He will be staking REPU at the personal token to get some address' rToken.
Because the total supply of personal tokens is fixed, only activities on the DApp ecosystem can form the price of the personal token.

- 🛍 REPU-market: Any DApp that uses a personal token as the base currency could be developed. How a personal token is actively traded in the DApp ecosystem can decide the price of the personal token.
We developed the Web3 labor market as an example of DApp. Anyone who wants to use the workforce of someone with a personal token should buy the token and pay the wage price. The personal token price of people with high skills might rise, and this price could also show the credit of someone.

- 💰 REPU-loan: Now the personal token price, which is personal credit, is decided. Additional DApp could be developed based on the token price.
The example DApp we developed is a personal credit-based loan service. People with high credit scores can use the DeFi service in a better condition.
